text: Imperial Pastry Sour Ale with Lemon, Mandarin and Orange (lemon puree, mandarin puree, malted oat, lactose, orange concentrate, lemon peel, vanilla and salt)The official dessert of Queen Elizabeth's Platinum Jubilee

name: Szilvás Gombóc Gold EDT
text: Imperial Pastry Sour Ale With Plum, Vanilla, Walnuts, Cocoa Beans, Salt, Cinnamon, Lactose & Orange ZestSzilvás Gombóc imperial pastry sour with plum, cinnamon, and bourbon vanilla as a liquid take on one of the most iconic Hungarian plum dumpling desserts has been a bestseller as our first pastry sour, and after the sequels Szilvás Gombóc Double Cinnamon EDT, Tiny Barrel Project Szilvás Gombóc Rum and Szilvás Gombóc Triple Vanilla EDT now it's time for the ultimate edition! No artificial aromas, just natural ingredients.

name: Spectrum Series - Domesticated Beast Passion Fruit And Raspberry Parfait
text: We have not tamed a monster yet, but it’s our time now.

name: Barrel Aged Meggyes Pite
text: Blend of Four Roses Bourbon & Jamaican Rum Barrel Aged Sour Cherry Pie Imperial Pastry Sour AleWe have filled 2 barrels with one of our signature Hungarian cherry pie-inspired imperial pastry sour ale MEGGYES PITE and we have chosen not to release the result as BARREL PROJECT bottles, but in 330ml cans. Obviously, you can expect a thicker and silkier mouthfeel, where the winner of the epic battle between the characteristics of the barrel and the extra added vanilla is no one else, but you!

name: Sour Series - Unicorn Magic - Sparkle Edition
text: Az alap egy epres, szedres, guavás és lime-os pastry sour, amibe vaníliát is tettünk, hogy összehozza a gyümölcsök tagadhatatlanul vadító ízjegyeit, és persze laktózt is, hogy a savanykássága egy kis édességgel párosuljon és adja meg azt az ízélményt, amit belegondoltunk a sörbe. És akkor persze az alapsör kapott egy jó nagy adag ehető csillámot, ami kitöltéskor gyönyörű arany színűre varázsolja a sört. ENStrawberry, blackberry, guava, lime and vanilla give the perfect taste-orgy, while the golden glitters softly dance around in the bittersweet Pastry Sour Ale. With a 4,5%ABV, it's an easy to drink beer, with so much magic happening, that you're going to be amazed!

name: Vispipuuro
text: Imperial Pastry Sour with Cranberry & Vanilla collab with our friends from Tuju (FI)

name: DIS TEW MUCH
text: Double Fruited Blackcurrant Passion Fruit and Calamansi Smoothie Sour Ale

name: TesztAndrás Kappa.11
text: A Kappa.11 a magas alkoholtartalma ellenére is könnyen iható desszertsör, amiben a kedvenc málnás-csokis sütinket találjuk meg, csupán folyékony verzióban - legyen szó egy brownie-ról, egy gyümölcsös tejcsokoládéról, vagy a kedvenc csokitortánkról. Ez a süteményes ízeket felvonultató pastry ale kellemes játszik a savanykás-édes ízek összhangjával. Míg a tekintélyes malátaaddíció és csokoládé az édeskés ízekért felelős, a málna a savakat domborítja ki a kortyérzetben. Egy őszi bekuckózáshoz, esti nagy beszélgetésekhez, vagy egy finom süti mellé nem lehet mellé lőni vele.

name: French Toast
text: French Toast Inspired Pastry Sour Ale With Raspberries, Blueberries, Strawberries And CinnamonWe like pastry sours indeed, but with the classic Hungarian releases Szilvás Gombóc-Rákóczi Túrós-Meggyes Pite the fun never stopped, only started: our French Toast is a delicious breakfast entree that is loved by many, caramelized, fruited and oh so enjoyable! Lactose makes it creamy, vanilla makes it rounded, cinnamon spices it up, and the fruits are, well, the cherry on top!

name: Tomato Kaos
text: Someone form Space Next freed Dimbo from the Lab. during. During the action he added tomato and lime leafs to the beer tanks. Unsecured sources reported that they found TomatoKAOS paintings on the wall. Police is investigation is going on because of harmed gastronomy.

name: Sour Series - Margherita Pizza Gose
text: Sounds crazy but trust us, this beer is something unique you probably never tried or thought of trying but, if you ever wanted to try how tomato and freshly picked basil works in a salted sour wheatbeer then here is your chance.

name: TZATZIKI
text: Vegetable gose with dill, garlic and cucumbers.

name: We Are Toxic
text: A KillerSick thrash metal bandával közösen készült sörünk. Egy masszív búzamaláta alap, amit savanyítottunk majd belga wit élesztővel erjesztettünk le. Mindezek után adtunk neki rengeteg paradicsomot, oregánót és bazsalikomot.A névválasztás sem véletlen, a srácok We are Toxic című száma ihlette a sört, amit Huszti Márk fősörfőzőnk készített el, és brutális lett, legalább annyira mint a címke :D

name: Beet Blood
text: A very unique, vegetably gose with a good portion of beetroot, spiced with a pinch of pink pepper and sea salt.

name: Sour Series Wood-Fired Margherita Pizza
text: What's more iconic than pizza and beer together? In this new episode of combinating them together we added a little beech wood smoked malt to enhance the traditional flavors of the classic Margherita pizza. Just the basics, tomato with freshly picked basil in a gose.

name: Sour Series - Grillmaster's Delight
text: BBQ szósz-ihlette gose paradicsommal és fűszerekkel, kollégánk, Viktor ötlete és receptje alapján. BBQ inspired gose made with tomato and spices, based on the crazy idea of our colleague, Viktor.

name: Sour Series - Papa Prosciutto & Funghi
text: A megszokott pizzás sör-sorozatunk 2025-ös tétele, egy szép adag füstölt malátával a sonkás, és egy adag gombával a gombás ízvilágért! Our beloved Pizza Series makes a comeback with this "Prosciutto & Funghi" version. With a nice amount of roasted malts for the Prosciutto taste and an even nicer amount of mushroom for the "Funghi" taste! Buon Appetito

name: KEG X UNITY Gose v1
text: A Unity Bar ＆ Brewery és a KEG Sörművház közös projektje. "Hosszú hónapok óta érezzük, hogy hiányzik a választékunkból egy stabil minőségű, állandó savanyú sör, amely szintén nem drága, tényleg alapízű és valóban savanyú. Könnyebbséget jelent ebben a projektben nekünk, hogy pultos brigádunk néhány tagja aktív, vagy éppenséggel inaktív sörfőző, így gyakorlati oldalról is megtámasztott a folyamat. Így jutottunk arra a döntésre, hogy kell a KEG-be egy olyan Gose, amely négy dolgot biztos tud: sós, savanyú, korianderes és alsó középkategóriás áron adható, és nem akar túlmutatni a fajtajellemzők biztosította kereteken. "

name: Red Speedo
text: Az Ugar Brewery extrafriss, a nyár utolsó perzselő sugaraihoz főzött söre pont olyan, mint névadója, az alföldi strandok és focipályák hőse: Fecskekapitány!A főzdében igyekeztek olyan karaktert alkotni, amivel különcsége ellenére – vagy pont azért – sokan tudnak azonosulni. Az új sör egy gose, amely kellemesen, éppenhogy sós, jólesően savanyú, és játékosan komlós.

name: Night Shift Vintage 2024 - Triticale Wine Aged In Gemenc Whiskey & Tennessee Whiskey Barrels
text: Till Áron sörfőzőnk ötlete. A tritikálé, ami a búza és a rozs keresztezéséből született hibrid, mindkét alapgabona íz- és illatjegyeit magában hordozza, és ezt maga a sör, illetve a hordós érlelés csak jobban kihozta. A sör egyik felét a Gemenc Whiskey-től kapott, tritikálé alapú whiskey-t érlelt hordóiban érleltük, a másik fele Tennessee hordókba került, majd ennek a blendjéből született meg a végleges forma. Triticale, a hybrid of wheat and rye, carries the flavor and aroma characteristics of both base grains, and the beer itself, along with barrel aging, brings these out even more. We aged half of the beer in barrels from Gemenc Whiskey, which had been used to age triticale-based whiskey, the other half went into Tennessee barrels.

name: Night Shift Vintage 2025 / Buckwheat Wine Aged In Tennessee Whiskey Barrels
text: Tennessee Whiskey hordóban érlelt hajdinabor2025-ben is folytatjuk a gabonabor-sorozatunkat - de most valami egészen szokatlan jön.Ezúttal a hajdina kapta a főszerepet: egy Ázsiából származó növény, amit ugyan nem gabonafélének, mégis annak használunk, hiszen magjából liszt készül, mint a búzából.Mi a hajdinát malátázott formában tettük az alapsörbe, majd Tennessee Whiskey hordókban érleltük, amíg ki nem bontakozott teljes, gazdag, gabonaboros karaktere.Ne tévesszen meg a név — ez nem a „hajdinabor”, amit desztillálnak vagy fermentálnak, hanem egy különleges, sörként főzött gabonabor, tele a hajdina földes, diós mélységeivel és a whiskey hordók meleg, vaníliás aromáival.-Buckwheat Grain Wine - Aged in Tennessee Whiskey BarrelsIn 2025, we’re continuing our experimental grain wine series — but this time, we’re doing something truly unconventional.Meet the buckwheat edition: a plant native to Asia, not technically a grain, yet often used as one thanks to its wheat-like seeds.We used malted buckwheat in the base beer, then aged it in Tennessee Whiskey barrels until it reached its perfect, rich, grain wine character.Don’t confuse this with traditional “buckwheat wine” — this isn’t distilled or fermented like wine. It’s a beer-based grain wine, showcasing the earthy, nutty depth of buckwheat, beautifully rounded by warm vanilla and oak notes from the whiskey barrels.

name: Almás Rétes
text: Az Almás Rétes az első, már-már cukrászati szempontból is irigylésre méltó Szent András pastry ale, ami az osztrák barátaink világhírű almásrétesének, - ahogy ők nevezik: Apfelstrudel - mintájára készült el még Kappa.04 TesztAndrás kísérletként. Sörünk olyannyira sikeres lett, hogy mostantól megtaláljátok az állandó kínálatban is. Az osztrák rétest többnyire vaníliafagylalttal szolgálják fel, így a valódi vanília őrlemény ebből a sörből sem hiányozhat. Savanykás almás jegyek, intenzív fahéj és édeskés vaníliaillat egy nem túl édes, de sörként és sütiként is fenséges desszertsörben.

name: Collabrew Series #3 - Kollabors
text: A Collabrew Series harmadik tagját, stílusosan három tag álmodta meg. Egy sörfőző, egy gerilla, és az „Untappd srác”. Sok hétköznapi dologra nem nagyon lehet számítani ebből a felállásból. Itt van például ez a saison. Nem elég, hogy több mint 40% búzamalátával készült, még borítottunk bele egy szakajtónyi rózsaborsot is. Persze a hidegkomlózás sem maradhatott el. Mosaic komlót és még egy kis rózsaborsot kapott, mert abból ugye sosem elég. A végeredmény pedig egy késő tavaszi, igazi, elképesztő szomjoltó serital lett!Javasolt fogyasztási hőmérséklete 10°C.

name: Nyúlon Túl '19
text: A Nyúlon Túl nem csak egy „ártalmatlan kis nyuszika” söre, de az idei barbecue-szezonnyitó sztárja is. A red ale és sört megfűszerező közepesen erős, bükkfán füstölt, chiliszósz harmóniája nem csak a húsok ízét dobja fel, de magát a főzést is. Sörünkhöz a békés megyei Kígyóscsili aranyérmes chipotle szószát adtuk, hogy legyen szó bármilyen helyzetről, mi izzítsuk a hangulatot.

name: Esthajnal '14 - Batch #2
text: Az Esthajnal sorozat második darabjában, az Esthajnal ’14-ben az ünnepi hangulat mellett magát a karácsonyfát is palackba töltöttük. Sörünkbe annyi lucfenyőhajtás került, hogy a főzőház is majdnem megsínylette a folyamatot. Az eredmény magáért beszél, elkészíteni nektek a kihívások ellenére is megérte.

name: Pepper Rangers
text: Ki ne hallott volna a Collabrew szériáról a Reczer Sertől? Emlékeztek a legendás trió, Utassy Roli, Rage és Reczer Gabi összeállására, amikor megalkották a Kollaborsot? Naná, hogy igen!Abba a szerencsés helyzetbe kerültünk, hogy zöld utat kapott egy újabb főzet belőle, ezer hála érte srácok!Most az etyeki sörguruk (Márk és Kende) álltak össze a Wicked Water arcaival (Rage és Zoli), leporolták ezt a receptet. Picit igazítottak rajta a saját szájízük szerint, és elkészítették újra ezt a tételt. Pattintsatok rá és üljetek fel a nosztalgiavonatra! Egs!És mi is ez a sör? Egy masszív búzaalapú White Saison, ami rengeteg rózsaborssal lett megfűszerezve, mellé egy laza 6,1%-os alkoholtartalommal áldottuk meg.

name: Geisha
text: Jázminnal és zöld teával.

name: Gesztenye
text: Eleinte év végi ünnepekre, majd később a nagy fogyasztói igény hatására egész éven át készített, gesztenyeliszt és bourbon vanília hozzáadásával előállított különlegesség. A sör színében aranybarna, ízében a gesztenyéhez méltó jegyekkel lett felruházva. A gesztenyét kedvelő fogyasztók körében a sör minden kortya kellemes hangulatot teremthet számunkra.

name: Gigi
text: Mézes gyömbéres

name: Nut To Butt
text: ChuckTR (Asterisk Mountain Brewers) egyike a legtehetségesebb hazai sörfőzőknek, így amikor felvetődött a kollaboráció ötlete, azonnal igent mondtunk rá. Végül a Wicked Nuclear Rahoron nevű receptjének pekándiós változatát „skáláztuk fel”, így született meg ez a csokoládéval, vaníliával és persze pekándióval főzött American milk stout. A stílusnak megfelelően alaposan megkomlóztuk, így ideális balanszban vannak az édes és keserű ízjegyek, nem válik émelyítővé az élmény, inkább mintha egy folyékony desszertet kortyolnál.--ChuckTR (aka Asterisk Mountain Brewers) is one of the most talented homebrewers of the local scene. So when he asked us whether we’d be interested in a collaboration we immediately knew the answer. We took his already well-known and loved Russian Imperial Stout, Wicked Nuclear Rahoron and tweaked the recipe until we were both happy with the results. That’s how Nut To Butt, an American milk stout brewed with pecan, chocolate and Madagascar vanilla came together. We heavily hopped it to achieve an ideal balance between pine-y and sweet flavours; it’s like drinking a liquid dessert.

name: Black Mamma
text: A Black Mamma egy könnyű fekete kávés stout, visszafogott keserűséggel, de lehengerlő kávéillattal, csak kávéfogyasztóknak. Könnyen csúszik, de minden korsóban két presszó mocorog. Hajnalig iható, pörgős, könnyed 6%-os lopakodó.

name: Baristaut
text: Hármas együttműködésben megalkotott, “duplán kávés” stout – a recept Gárdos Zsolt baristával közös művünk, Etióp Sidamo kávéját pedig a Blckest pörkölte. Az eredmény egy karakteres, kiegyensúlyozott frissítő: kávé és sör tökéletes összhangja. Egy emberként szeretjük.

name: Esthajnal '16
text: A karácsonyi édességek kísérője, de akár helyettesítője is lehet a Szent András Sörfőzde Esthajnal-sorozatának negyedik darabja, az Esthajnal '16. Ünnepi desszertsörünkben a menta frissítő lendülete találkozik a csokoládé adta élvezetekkel és a stoutok krémes, bársonyos ízkarakterével. Az Esthajnal '16-ot sörfőzőmesterünk úgy alkotta meg, hogy az ünnepek alatt mindig legyen jó ok egy meghitt, karácsonyi sörözéshez.

name: The Blackening
text: Tejcsokis, citrusos illatok alól bontakozik ki a komplex ízélmény, melyet az amerikai komlók és a pörkölt maláták biztosítanak. A hidegkomlózás miatt kevésbé komlós keserű, viszont sokkal illatosabb és zamatosabb. Krémesen csúszó desszertsör.

Hét fajta maláta keveréke adja a az édes/kávés/kesernyés ízkombinációt. Az első kortyok után nehéz is eldönteni, hogy édes, vagy keserű ízt érezni?! Gyönyörű, krémes habja van, szinte harapni lehet. A fűszerezést kétfajta komlóval végezzük.

name: Dark Steam
text: Összetevők: müncheni maláta, pilseni maláta, carafa III, carafa I, zabpehely, Magnum komló, Chinook komló, ale élesztő.

name: Darkness Be My Friend
text: stout marc felhasználásávalamerican stout craft beer with Marcszűretlen pasztőrözetlen/unfiltered unpasteurizedA Szekszárdi Márc egy ősi recept alapján, mézből és cukorból készített szörp, Petrits József mézeskalácsos mester öröksége alapján.összetevők: ivóvíz, árpamaláta, karamell maláta, csokoládé maláta, pirított árpa, Márc (cukor,víz,méz,karamell), komló, sörélesztőingredients: water, barley malt, crystal malt, chocolate malt, roasted barley, Marc (sugar,water,honey,caramel), hops (Magnum, Styrian Goldings, Cascade), yeast

name: Selfish Games - Beantown Tea Party
text: Kellemesen komlós, American stout, 6,2%-os alkoholtartalommal, Till Áron sörfőző receptje alapján. A stoutra jellemző kávés ízjegyek találkozása a komló kesernyésségével és a bergamot jellegzetesen citrusos ízvilágával egy teljesen új, páratlan íz-orgiává teljesedik ki, főleg a sör hőfokának változásával. Ajánljuk nem teljesen lehűtve fogyasztani.This American Stout is the perfect meet-cute of coffee notes from the stout, the HBC-630's hoppy flavor and the sour notes of the Ear Grey and bergamot oil. The extraordinary taste reaches its full potential once the beer reaches the best temperature, which is definitely not ice-cold.

name: MONYO x One Beer: Mango x Maple Syrup Stout
text: This is not just a beer; it’s the result of an exciting experiment that opens new dimensions in flavor! We’ve reimagined MONYO’s previous mango-maple syrup recipe with a silky and intense stout base. It was Szilárd’s idea to combine the rich, roasted notes of dark malts with the tropical freshness of mango and the sweet, caramel-like depth of maple syrup. And he was absolutely right!A sip of this specialty is like tasting a dessert: full-bodied, creamy, and playfully fruity. The seriousness of the stout and the sweetness of the mango-maple syrup duo invite your taste buds to a harmonious dance where roasted, sweet, and fruity notes unite perfectly.Try it and step with us into a new universe of flavors!

name: Singularity - Irish Coffee Stout
text: Singularity is an ode to boozy, creamy coffee.A big coffee and chocolate malt body, full of toffee and raw sugar notes, serves as the foundation, balanced with a touch of lactose. We then cold-infuse a specially-selected blend of single-origin beans from Budapest's own Bagira Coffee: two Brazilian roasts for creamy, nougaty espresso character, and an El Salvadorian dark roast for tobacco and red fruit notes.

name: Singularity NITRO - Irish Coffee Stout
text: SERVED ON NITROSingularity is an ode to boozy, creamy coffee. A big coffee and chocolate malt body, full of toffee and raw sugar notes, serves as the foundation, balanced with a touch of lactose. We then cold-infuse a specially-selected blend of single-origin beans from Budapest's own Bagira Coffee: two Brazilian roasts for creamy, nougaty espresso character, and an El Salvadorian dark roast for tobacco and red fruit notes.Served on nitro for a luxuriously smooth pour.

name: Exoplanet: San Ignacio - Single Origin Coffee Stout
text: SERVED ON NITROExoplanet is a quarterly series purpose-built to highlight single-origin coffees from Budapest's own Bagira Coffee.The foundation is a cleaner, softer stout which lets our coffee selections shine through: a bold dark malt baseline tempered with tons of silky oat body and a touch of lactose.San Ignacio hails from several nano-scale producers within Peru's Cajamarca region, where high altitudes, fertile volcanic soil, and tropical rains create perfect growing conditions. Here, small farmers prioritize quality and sustainability, handpicking the beans before gently wash-processing and fermenting them. Bagira's light roast perfectly accentuates this bean’s delicate notes of freshly-baked brownies, blueberry jam, and plum compote.

name: Tsunami
text: Megfogalmazódott bennünk egy olyan sör gondolata, amivel átlépjük a saját korlátainkat. Rozsos stout, kávéval és bourbon hordó chips-szel. Erős, királyi darab, a tsunami elsöprő erejével. Egészségetekre!

name: Collabrew Series #10 - Tropical Tiger
text: A Balkezes Urakkal ’Pimp my tank’ névrekereszteltük a projektet, melyben a másodikvilágháborús, már harcedzett T30 harckocsifejlesztésébe fogtunk. Vázig bontottuk agépszörnyet, kicsit hegesztettünk amalátaalapon, kidobtuk a tejcukrot,megerősítettük a koffein vonalat. Nem isakárhogy. Külső segítségként bevontuk egyújhullámos kávépörkölő manufaktúrát, amiolyan brazil koffein lövegeket készítettnekünk, ami felér egy fejlövéssel. Így álltössze a pusztító páncélos, a Tropical Tiger!

name: Fake Macchiato
text: Barátaink a 42 Coffee Roasterytől egy újabb intergalaktikus hírnevű kávéval örvendeztetettek minket: ezúttal az egyedi pörkölésű El Salvador Bourbon Black Honey kávét pörgettük át 24 órán keresztül legújabb milk stoutunkon. A közel 250 espressonyi kávétkrémes, szinte édes milk stouttal vegyítve kaptuk meg ezt a pörköltkávés, kicsit mézes sört mely egy fekete lyuk gravitációjávalvonzza az ízlelőbimbókat. Bögréből is tökéletes!

name: Optimus Stout
text: Meglepő bejelentést tett október elején a szekszárdi Bodri Pincészet: piacra dobták az Optimus Stoutot. A sör azt a sort folytatja, amelybe az Optimus Étterem, az Optimus Lucky Cap kávé és persze az Optimus Cuvée tartozik.Az Optimus a Szekszárdi borvidék első olyan étterme volt, amely borászatnál működik, a’la carte konyhával, és egész évben nyitva van. Ugyancsak az Optimus névvel illetik a Bodri pincészet egyik zászlósborát, az Optimus Cuvéet, és a sorozat része a borhoz komponált kávé, az Optimus Lucky Cap blend is. A legújabb tagja a prémium családnak pedig az Optimus Stout, amelyet a Horizont Brewing főzött a szekszárdi borászat számára, és amivel sikerült meghökkenteni a boros közeget.

name: Szümpla
text: Collab with 42 Coffe Hungary

name: Merry Berry!
text: Bár az ünnepi szokások eltérőek, szenteste másnapján az alábbi dolgok vesznek körül. Van aki a romok eltakarítasának áll neki rögtön, van aki csöndesen süpped egy új könyvvel a kanapéba.Bármelyik táborba is tartozol, ezzel a csúszós, málnával és lágy brazil kávéval bőven megkínált stouttal nem indulhat rosszul a reggeled!

name: Morning Joe
text: A cup of joe in the morning? Specialty roasted coffee and selected cocoabeans makes this brew intense and reviving, the tons of oatflakes makes it super creamy, like your favorite capuccino. So, fancy a cup of joe in the morning? (Or at any time of the day...)Egy feketét reggelire? Az egyedi pörkölésű kávétól markáns és ébresztő, a hozzáadott rengeteg zabpehelytől pedig krémes és selymes, mint a kedvenc cappuccino-d. Na, akkor egy feketét reggelire? (Vagy bármikor…)

name: Kotyogós
text: Dark ale with coffee

name: Glam Stout
text: Jó ideje törtük a fejünket, hogy főzni kellene egy alacsony alkoholtartalmú, de mégis testes, kávés stoutot. Ez lett a Glam Stout, aminek ízesítéséért brazil El Salvador specialty kávé felel.We have been thinking about brewing a low ABV, yet full-bodied coffee stout for a while now. The result is the Glam Stout, infused with Brazilian El Salvador specialty coffee.

name: Catacombs Coffee Stout
text: A Catacombs Coffee Stoutnál mögött az volt a gondolat, hogy szerettünk volna egy komolyabb, de közérthetőbb stílust még népszerűbbé tenni itthon. A kávé adja magát, mivel a sötét stout alap már eleve adhat ilyen asszociációkat, amire a specialty kávéval csak még jobban ráerősítettünk, miközben nem viszi el mégsem túlságosan extrém irányba az ízélményt. Itt mindkét csapat fantáziája szabadon szárnyalhatott, ez egy hálás feladat és kiérződik a sörből is. Lágy malátásság és szénsavasság, valamint kávés, kakaós, keserű csokis, karamellás és enyhén a komlótól keserű íz jellemzi.

name: Ön Matt
text: Önmatt. A feladvány, amelyben a sötétet arra kényszerítjük, hogy mattot adjon. Az erőteljes, krémes, kávés, csokis fekete sör adott, a feladat adott. Kezdődjön a játék, és gratulálunk a győztesnek!

name: Sherwood
text: A 2012-es miskolci sörversenyre készítettük, megcélozva vele egy a Tuck Baráthoz méltó fekete ALE (Stout) változatot. Nyolc fajta maláta keverékével van cefrézve. Különleges íz világát a speciális komlózásnak köszönheti. A színe mély fekete, EBC 52-es. 14C°-on fogyasztandó.

name: The Healer
text: If you like coffee and dark chocolate then this beer is for you. It's easy to drink but also serious just like the label which was designed by Robert Borbas aka Grindesign. Recommended music: Blackened Death Metal.

name: Midnight Express
text: A proper foreign stout with velvety, creamy foam. Cold roasted coffee, smoky scents and flavors are dominant. As the beer warms up a light chocolate flavor can be tasted.

name: Moment In Time 2021 Vanilla
text: 2019. decemberében főztük, majd 2020 január elejétől 2021 május végéig grain whisky hordóban érleltük. Végül palackozás előtt kapott egy kis organikus mexikói vaníliát. Olajosan sűrű, édes, komplex sörital.

name: Moment In Time 2022 Mexican Vanilla
text: 11 hónapig ír grain whisky hordókban érleltük, majd palackozás előtt került bele egy kis organikus mexikói vanília. Olajosan sűrű, csokoládés ízvilágú, komplex sörital.

name: Nasty Riff
text: Mexican Cake Inspired Imperial Stout collab with Adroit Theory (USA)

name: Moment In Time 2024: Calvados & Apple Brandy Barrel
text: A 50-50 Calvados and Apple Brandy barrel aged imperial stout blended into a single experience. Very moderate carbonation, smooth oily body and rich chocolate aromas, the stout is complemented by a mild, refreshing acidity imparted by the Brandy barrels.

name: Somlói Galuska 2024
text: Our most ambitious collab ever including our amazing friends:Mixen of Culture Drops from DenmarkMárk of Moersleutel from the NetherlandsBoti of B*Bop Fermentory from HungaryMAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTRum Barrel-Aged Pastry Imperial Stout With Walnut, Pecan, Cocoa Beans, Raisins And VanillaCELLAR MASTER NOTESTake time to do what makes your soul happyThe original Somlói Galuska was a real milestone for the Barrel Project when we made it back in 2019 with our dear friends at Moersleutel. It was the first barrel-aged pastry imperial stout for us as well as the first collab within the series and, you've been our witness, we learned so much from these guys. The second release Somlói Nodler already set the bar higher, but we are pretty sure that this third coming of the Somlói is 'the crème de la crème', a real blast of flavours and memories. Eat it and drink it, you sure deserve this treat!

name: Moment In Time 2024: Maple Syrup
text: Moment In Time sorozatunk tagjai hordóérlelt, stout típusú komplex fekete söritalok, melyek a maláták összhangjára épülnek.15 éves, 200 literes amerikai – korábban kanadai juharszirupot tartalmazó – tölgyfahordóban 13 hónapig érlelt stout típusú fekete sör.Összesen 320 palack készült.

name: Happy Finish Pedro Ximenez
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTBlended Barrel Aged Imperial Stout and PorterCELLAR MASTER NOTESPedro Ximenez is one of the noblest grape varieties that sherry is made from. We had the ultimate luck to get one of these barrels this special spirit had been aged in so we didn't waste time and filled it immediately.The Cuban rum strikes back! After Happy Finish Tawny port, which in fact was the first part of this mini-series, we used this type of barrel again to mature the very same peanut imperial stout, but this time we mixed it with Pedro Ximenez BA imperial porter to add the unique characteristics of sherry to the game. Long story short: it's a Black Forest Cake-party in your mouth! Bitter chocolate, molasses, walnut and a huge amount of berries with an acidic aftertaste. Yummy!

name: Moment In Time 2021
text: Imperial stout with lots of oatmalt and oat flakes aged 16 months in Irish grain whiskey barrels. 2019. decemberében főztük, majd 2020 január elejétől 2021 május végéig grain whisky hordóban érleltük. Olajosan sűrű, édes, komplex sörital

name: Happy Finish 2024 - Eaux De Vie Prune
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTPort Wine And Plum Liquor Double Barrel Aged Imperial StoutCELLAR MASTER NOTESIn this bottle, you can find the beautiful harmony of port wine and dried plum brandyWe came back fifth time with this series in series concept, the Happy Finish, where we double barrel age nasty imperial stouts, finishing them in particularly interesting barrels, in this case, french dried plum brandy, which spoke for itself immediately at the first sniff. Rich fruitiness, deep dried flavours, backboning chocolate and some berries from the port barrel. Altogether 2 and a half years of wood maturing had a deep impact indeed. Not only on the beer but also on us!

name: Simulation Theory - Mexico
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTBourbon Barrel Aged Imperial Milk Stout With Mexican Vanilla BeansCELLAR MASTER NOTESJust a kind invitation to our very own simulation if you are willing to open your mindAfter 3 releases in two years, we return with one of our most popular series, Simulation Theory. This year we decided to get one of the most famous varieties of this precious spice, the Mexican, and put it in an even more sticky and creamy base beer which is enriched with lactose and candid sugar. The result is sweet and aromatic with pleasant notes of wood and chocolate. If you are lucky enough you may have one or two bottles left from the previous releases so you can tag along. No worries if not, the year 2024 marks the arrival of another new variety. Crazy times!

name: Tiny Barrel Project Tennessee Dice Roller Scotch & Bourbon
text: Scotch & Bourbon Barrel Aged Imperial Stout with Almond & Vanilla together with our friends at Brætspilscaféen in Horsens being released first during the ROLLING WITH THE PUNCHES TOUR 2024 in DenmarkFollowing TINY BARREL PROJECT SPIRITLORD RUM and TINY BARREL PROJECT CANDY MAN SCOTCH and so, here is our 11th TINY BARREL PROJECT release in our new category between the Specials series and Barrel Project in 330ml cans

name: Horror Vacui
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTScotch And Bourbon Barrel Aged Imperial Stout With Smoked Cocoa, Rosemary And Smoked SaltCELLAR MASTER NOTESWe are simple brewersIf we find emptiness in the sip, we fill it with weird plants and strange salts. From time to time we take big risks and move away from the comfort zone of nuts-vanilla-sweet spices to try some nonsense. In this case, the motivation came from culinary experiences where the rosemary, the cocoa, and the salt are long-time friends, so why not to try them in beer, maybe alongside with some smoke? The base itself is a blend of scotch and bourbon barrel-aged imperial stout that brings chocolate, vanilla, and strong oak notes to the party. The result is an unusual banger (according to our humble opinion, of course).

name: Happy Finish Tawny Port
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTBlended Barrel Aged Imperial Stout and PorterCELLAR MASTER NOTESIn this bottle you can find the wonderful unity between our very first - but definitely not the last - Tawny Port Barrel aged imperial porter and a Cuban rum Barrel aged imperial peanut stout.We have filled one of our first casks in the brewery back in 2018 with the porter. It wasn't a quick finish as the taste needed almost 2 years to mature, but the vibrating duo of raisin and sour cherry will convince you, just like the tannic tones at the end of the sip, that patience is a virtue. It takes two to make a quarrel though; Cuban rum rounds the composition with notes of bitter chocolate and walnut. The results? Close your eyes and succumb to the temptation of our Cognac sour cherry bonbon...

name: Tiny Barrel Project Mean Riff Tokaji
text: Hungarian Wine Barrel Aged Imperial Stout With Walnuts, Cacao Beans And Vanilla made together with our friends and partners The Nitrox Pub & Eatery in KotorAfter NASTY RIFF Mexicake Inspired Imperial Stout we presented you MEAN RIFF Hungarian Walnut Cake Infused Imperial Stout in the June of 2023:"Big sounds, weird guitars, big flavours, no artificial add-ons, just the precious ingredients our grandmothers use for our favorite cakes"We waited until the September of 2024 to release this special blend where we used two different barrels of the most famous Hungarian dessert wine!

name: Tiny Barrel Project Candy Man Scotch
text: The TINY BARREL PROJECT version of one of our most famous Specials: CANDY MAN  Marshmallows and Tonka Beans Imperial Stout from the January of 2018:Scotch Whiskey Barrel Aged Imperial Stout with Marshmallows and Tonka Beans with our friends at Beeráló - Craft Beer Pub in Székesfehérvár Following TINY BARREL PROJECT SPIRITLORD RUM and TINY BARREL PROJECT SPIRITLORD BOURBON and so, here is our 10th TINY BARREL PROJECT release in our new category between the Specials series and Barrel Project in 330ml cans

name: Happy Finish 2025 - Tokaji Barrel
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTTokaji Aszú Barrel-Aged Imperial StoutCELLAR MASTER NOTESIn this bottle, you can find the beautiful symphony by the king of winesAs the sixth release of the Happy Finish series, we’ve now reached full authenticity using the most iconic and oldest Hungarian finishing barrel, cherished by spirit makers all over the continent, the Tokaji Aszú cask. This one was filled with sweet and flavorful wine, full of walnut and raisin character, traditionally enjoyed on special occasions. However, don’t be confused… You always deserve the finest, and we strive to provide it. Open a bottle, fill your glass, fill your soul, and drink like the royalty you are.

name: Coco-Choco Armageddon
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTBourbon Barrel Aged Imperial Stout with roasted coconut and cocoa beansCELLAR MASTER NOTESWe know. Talking about Bounty in a coconut-chocolate stout is such a cliché but we cannot afford not to do so. From the first sniff until the last sip coconut is everywhere complemented by a more bitter than sweet chocolate tone. A little vanilla and lots of chocolate come from the bourbon barrel but this time we resisted the temptation and didn't add more vanilla to the composition as the true character of chocolate seemed to be more fascinating. Our second BA coconut imperial stout (after Monster Monday) flashes a completely different side of this nut (that isn't actually a nut).

name: When They Bring The Nasty Riff Back But Slower
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTMezcal And Hot Sauce Barrel Aged Imperial Stout With Cocoa, Chillies And SpicesThe Barrel Aged Version of our previous collab with Adroit Theory (USA) NASTY RIFFCELLAR MASTER NOTESHushed and GrimmedThe Nasty Riff came back. You believed Nasty Riff was a one-hit-wonder… But you were all deceived. Damn right son, another version was made. In the dark depths of the barrel room, in a mezcal and a hot sauce barrel, this few hundred liters of this bitingly intense imperial stout was put aside to wait for its time to strike again. Very light hint of spicy smokiness and an even deeper form of chili and hotness. This release will be our second form of collaboration with the mighty Adroit Theory but if we can tell you a secret, a third will emerge soon!

name: Simulation Theory 2023 Tahiti
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTBourbon Barrel Aged Imperial Stout With Tahitian VanillaCELLAR MASTER NOTESJust a kind invitation to our very own simulation if you are willing to open your mindThis beer is not just the revival of the infamous Simulation Theory originally released back in 2019, but also part of a miniseries, where we created an upgraded imperial stout base, divided it into 2 parts, and then filled them into similar Kentucky bourbon barrels, to finish them with 2 different kinds of vanilla to see what happens, focusing on the contrasts. Hereby we cordially invite you on this journey to discover all these amazing nuances. Spoiler alert: both of them are incredibly walnutty-chocolaty from the barrel itself and the Tahiti and Madagascar vanillas are in perfect symbiosis with these flavors. We're not here to judge though. Only you are!

name: EVOLUTION 2021 COCOA
text: Brewed in november 2020, this rye imperial stout is extremely oily and complex. Infused with Venezuelan and Nicaraguan Cocoa nibs.

name: Extreme Plum Terror
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTCuban Rum Barrel Aged Imperial Stout With Dried Plum And CinnamonCELLAR MASTER NOTESIn disorder you can always find harmony.As the seventh son of this batch of imperial stout (with brothers like Ghost of a Rose, Mr. Peanutbutter, Choco-Coco Armageddon), this bastard delivers a seventh totally different variety for a stout: fruits and spices. It was the first time we used dried fruits to a BA release and it has turned out very lovely with the raisiny sweet notes of plum and got perfectly completed by the woody-spicy cinnamon and the moderately strong but quite deep flavors of the Cuban rum barrel. Maybe it's time to bring fruits to Barrel Project and unleash chaos? Hell yeah.

name: Never Before #1
text: Port ruby BA double imperial stout on raspberry

name: EVOLUTION 2020
text: 2020. január 3-án főztük. Olajosan sűrű, édes, komplex sörital a hidegebb napokra.Összesen 350 palack készült.

name: Chef's Bottle
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECT team series Norbert Piszkor [Madhouse Budapest executive chef]Jamaican Rum Barrel Aged Imperial StoutCELLAR MASTER NOTESDo not eat. Taste. Savor. Relish.In general, our brewery doesn't embrace the mindset of "Simple is better" but sometimes it comes in that beautiful form we are just unable to ignore it. For this release, we used a freshly emptied Jamaican rum barrel and filled it up with our base imperial stout we've been improving for years now to provide the perfect backbone for our barrel project. The result is a chocolaty-spicy-somewhat fruity, full-bodied, yet not sweet, thick, black stout which never ceases to amaze the crew, anytime we pop a bottle.

name: Tennessee Dice Roller
text: Imperial Stout with Almond and VanillaTry it - pair it - blend it with QUEEN OF GRACELAND Imperial Milk Shake Pale Ale with Sour Cherry and Coconut

name: Mr. Peanutbutter
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECT Double Barrel Aged Imperial StoutCELLAR MASTER NOTESImagine a spoon of peanut butter that is so thick you can't even swallow it. Now imagine it in a beer.The substance you can find in this bottle had a more exciting past than most of us. We started with brewing an amazingly strong and rich imperial stout with tons of peanuts and aged it in a Four Roses barrel. When the taste of bourbon got vibrant after a year, we poured it into a Pedro Ximenez sherry barrel for a finish and as a final act, a crazy amount of peanut has been added again. All of these efforts turned into a wonderful unity between wood, vanilla, chocolate, cherry, plum, and at last but not least: P-E-A-N-U-T!

name: Stachio Bois
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECT Bourbon Barrel Aged Vanilla Bean Pistachio Cake Imperial Pastry StoutCELLAR MASTER NOTESPistachio is the king of the nut family so we didn't hesitate to put a golden crown on this bottle. But wax is far from being the only thing that makes it noble: it sat for more than a year in a bourbon barrel and we added vanilla to round up the tastes and balance the light saltiness. To be honest, we had nothing to do here: the enormous amount of nuts did most of the job. The chocolaty stout mixed with the oriental vibes of pistachios got twisted by a bit of vanilla, it is soft with moderated carbonation, and the feeling it delivers is royal. We recommend it to everybody who's ready to admire a sticky-toffee-nutty-chocolaty-vanilla boi.

name: Supernova - Imperial Almond Stout
text: Supernova builds on our core range almond stout's incredible reception, pushing Nova's recipe deep into imperial territory to create a luxuriously rich, complex version for our stout fans.This is an enormous beer: rich aromas of roasted almonds lead into a silky smooth, oat-heavy base full of dark chocolate notes tempered with a touch of lactose sweetness.Long conditioning on toasted cherry wood adds further depth to turn Supernova into a truly indulgent treat, perfect for any winter evening.

name: Evolution 2023
text: Our rye imporial stout with 8 types of malts. Oily body, komplex taste.

name: Never Before #3
text: Tawny portwood whiskey BA double imperial stout

name: Evolution 2020 Cocoa
text: Brewed in january 2020, this rye imperial stout is extremely oily and complex. Infused with Venezuelan and Nicaraguan Cocoa nibs. 225 bottles where made.

name: Uenuku
text: Ezt az Imperial Stoutot a tartályérlelés után három részre osztottuk. Egy Martinique mellett két jamaicai (egy szűz és egy használt tölgy) rumoshordóban érleltük 8 hónapig, mielőtt blendeléssel újra egyesítettük.This Imperial Stout was split into three parts after fermentation. These were then filled into 3 barrels: a Martinique and two Jamaican rum (one virgin, on used). After 8 months these parts were once again reunited trough blending.

name: Zenith - Imperial Chocolate Orange Stout
text: Thanks to a double dose of Gravity-roasted Peruvian cacao nibs, this luxuriously boozy milk chocolate stout evokes memories of steaming cups of hot cocoa and delicious Christmas desserts.Cold nitrogenation rounds out the mouthfeel by delivering an incredibly smooth body and creamy head, while a delicate orange marmalade finish gently brings you back to your senses for another sip.

name: Only The Mad Are Sane
text: A Blend Of Maple Syrup Barrel-Aged Imperial Stout, Martinique Rum Barrel-Aged Ryewine And Smoky Whisky Barrel-Aged Sweet Mead collab with our friend Erwin from Van Moll (NL) 4 kegs ever made for Van Moll Fest Winter Edition 2025

name: Moment In Time 2025: Heaven Hill Bourbon
Never Before #2
text: Tawny port BA double impreial stout

name: Tagaloa
text: Az Uenuku alapját is képező Imperial Stoutot ehhez a sörhöz Kentucky Bourbon hordókban érleltük, majd blendeltük. A krémes test mellé kiválóan párosulnak a bourbon jegyei!The same Imperial Stout that formed the basis to Uenuku was also aged in different Kentucky Bourbon barrels, then blended together. The creamy body pairs great with the bourbon's notes!

name: Lords of the Barrel - Vanilla & Tonka Beans
text: A duó  második tagja is rendkívül komplex ízvilággal rendelkezik. Nem émelyítően édes, hanem gyönyörűen lekerekített, sárgabarack befőtt ízeket villant, miközben a tonkabab és a vanília felváltva mutatkozik meg, valódi szépséggé alakítva ezt az alkoholtartalma miatt veszélyes szörnyeteget.

name: Nolala Land
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTMaple Syrup Barrel-Aged Imperial Stout With Pecan NutsCELLAR MASTER NOTES"It's a soul sense of prideGood lord, the South is blind"As a new thing, we started to use bourbon barrels for aging that were previously filled with maple syrup. Well, it turned out pretty awesome, it gave us much more taste than we would ever thought. As the cherry on top, we added a decent amount of handroasted pecan nuts to enhance the pleasure even more so we invite you to dive under with us to the depths of this woody, thick and nutty swamp.

name: Sleeping Giant
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTRum and Bourbon Double Barrel Aged Imperial StoutCELLAR MASTER NOTESThe giant slept for a year in Barbados rum barrels, then rested half more year in a second fill Woodford bourbon barrel. The double barrel aging made it an outstandingly complex beer. It smells like the childhood memory of roasting marshmallows on the campfire. This memory is complemented by coconut and burnt sugar. The beer bids farewell with a night long mouthfeel.

name: Mahuika
text: Alapja ugyanaz az Imperial Stout, amire Uenuku és Tagaloa is épül. Ezúttal a blendeléshez bourbon és brandy hordókban érlelt hányadokat használtunk fel, egy izgalmas, karakteres ízprofilért.The same base Imperial Stout that is shared with Uenuku and Tagaloa, aged in a blend of Bourbon and Brandy barrels.

name: Mango Cvlt
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTJamaican Rum Barrel-Aged Imperial Stout With Dried MangoCELLAR MASTER NOTES “Real smart begins when you quit quoting other people.”Sometimes it’s not that hard to tell if the sequel is better or worse than the original one. But with this one, things are getting really messy. As the second part of our 'aging imperial stouts in rum barrels and finishing them with dried fruits' miniseries (if you remember Pineapple Popup), we now used sundried mango that gave a similar vibe like pineapple: a tropical blast and the kiss of the summer built into a robust, spicy imperial stout. Who knows, maybe we'll end up as a trilogy with Papaya in the lead role!

name: Night of the Witch
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECT Gin Barrel Aged Imperial Stout with Pine Nuts, Pine Buds and Juniper BerriesCELLAR MASTER NOTESIt's the night of the witch, our coven sets your heart on fire‌It would be hard to deny that we have some special feelings towards the pines, the pines, where the sun never shines, so it was just a matter of time after Lumbersexual, Timbersexual or Needles and Pins that we released a Barrel Project within this theme. Celebrating Dopelord's new record, Night of the Witch attacks with a serious amount of pine nuts, freshly picked spruce tips and juniper berries. The result is an odd, somewhat Sahti-themed imperial stout with piney freshness and nutty deepness, absolutely not for everyone, but definitely for you.

name: From the Barrel Bourbon Barrel Aged Pecan Imperial Stout (2025)
text: A Wilderness Trail bourbon hordó és a pekándió elegáns párosa egy végtelenül komplex, rétegzett imperial stoutban vegyül el. Erőteljes, kifinomult, és olyan gazdag, hogy szinte harapni lehet.The elegant pairing of a Wilderness Trail bourbon barrel and pecan melds into an endlessly complex, layered imperial stout. Powerful, refined, and so rich you can practically bite into it.

name: Tiny Barrel Project Phat Boi Sherry
text: Even prettier, even hotter, even thicker! Our instant classic '4 bean' imperial stout needs no introduction to dark beer lovers, PHAT BOI is a dynamic blend of natural flavours and real ingredients! The tonka, cocoa, coffee and vanilla infused base has spent over a year in Oloroso Sherrys barrels, which has brought the creamy-cocoa palate to the forefront, while also adding raisins, red berries and woody notes to the mix.The first TINY BARREL PROJECT release in 2024 in collaboration with our friends Jégkert craft beer bar.

name: Collision Course - Imperial Salted Chocolate Stout
text: Collision Course is an adult chocolate experience: a full-bodied bittersweet sipping cocoa packed with the richest ingredients and boldest flavors.A double dose of dark-roasted Peruvian cacao nibs soak in a luxurious caramel and chocolate malt base, while a touch of umami-packed red miso lends salinity to the finish and savory depth to the palate. This explosive dark chocolate body is tempered with soft vanilla notes from toasted oak, patiently developed on our own proprietary infusion system.

name: Night Shift Vintage 2021 Russian Imperial Stout Aged In Bourbon Barrels With Chocolate And Coffee
text: Russian Imperial Stout aged in Bourbon Barrels with Chocolate and Coffee added to the beer to give it a more round and delightful taste.

name: Night Shift Vintage 2020 Russian Imperial Stout Aged In Bourbon Barrels With Chocolate & Coffee
text: This beer is a 12% ABV Russian Imperial Stout, that was brewed with 12 types of malts, 6 hours of boil time, and 3 months of fermenting to prepare it for a long journey in two types of freshly emptied Bourbon barrels. The finished beer was soaked on freshly roasted Ethiopean Coffee beans and cocoa beans from Ghana. The result is a beer rich in notes of coffee, chocolate, vanilla and bourbon which we gladly recommend for every beer lover.

name: Night Shift Vintage 2022 Russian Imperial Stout Aged In Bourbon Barrels with Chocolate & Coffee
text: In 2020, when we tasted the first version of this beer, we felt a sense of pride like never before. This feeling has persisted every year since then. Our base beer is a midnight black, full-bodied Russian imperial stout, which we then matured on freshly roasted Ethiopian variant of a Budapest specialty coffee roaster and Ghanaian cocoa beans. All this was poured into freshly emptied bourbon barrels and aged for nearly a year to reach its most beautiful form. Enjoy this splendid beer!2020-ban amikor megkóstoltuk ennek a sörnek az első verzióját, akkor olyan büszkeség fogott el bennünket, mint előtte még soha. Ezt az érzést azóta is minden évben érezzük. Az alapsörünk egy éjfekete, testes russian imperial stout, amit egy budapesti specialty kávépörkölő frissen pörkölt etiópiai variánsán és ghánai kakaóbabon érleltünk utána. Mindezt frissen ürített bourbon hordókba fejtettük és érleltük közel egy évig, hogy elérje a legszebb formáját.

name: Night Shift Vintage 2023 - Russian Imperial Stout Aged In Bourbon Barrels With Chocolate & Coffee
text: Minden évben meglep ennek a már kötelezővé vált tételnek a sokszínűsége. Az alapsör pörkölt malátás jegyei és a Bourbon hordók klasszikus, utánozhatatlan ízvilága már alapból egy egészen különleges, minden évben egyre harmonikusabb ízvilágot alkotnak az egy éves érlelés során, de az igazi varázslat a kakaó- és kávébab megszokott ízjegyeinek átvételekor történik. This beer surprises us each year, since the harmony between the base beer and the barrels turns out to be something magical. Add the classical taste of cocoa and coffee beans, and the perfect barrel aged beer is suddenly in front of you.

name: Tiny Barrel Project Roasters Paradise Costa Rica Las Lomas
text: Our Roasters Paradise collab series with CASINO MOCCA including the trio of ROASTERS PARADISE KIANDERI - KENYA, ROASTERS PARADISE KOKE SHALAYE - ETIÓPIA and ROASTERS PARADISE JAGUARA - BRAZÍLIA has been our favorite coffee releases forever. As an elevation for this project, we wanted to transfer this experience into our other smash-hit series, TINY BARREL PROJECT:Following TINY BARREL PROJECT SPIRITLORD RUM and TINY BARREL PROJECT CANDY MAN SCOTCH and so, here is our 13th TINY BARREL PROJECT release in our new category between the Specials series and Barrel Project in 330ml cans.Love project meets love project - who else could have been our collab partners for this one-of-a-kind experience, than MADHOUSE BUDAPEST. Get this release if you can, only 1 keg ever made for our downtown bistro & bar together with a really limited number of cans!

name: Lords of the Barrel - Coffee
text: A Mad Scientist és a Reketye sörfőzde többéves tapasztalata a hordóérlelésű sörök területén, a sok szakmai beszélgetés, az izzó sörszerelem eredménye ez a remekmű.Ízében a hordó vaníliás jegyei vannak előtérben, mellette menetel a Casino Mocca kávé, remekül egyensúlyozva a magas alkoholtartalmat.

name: Antimatter - Imperial Coffee Stout
text: For those of you who drink 8% coffee stouts for breakfast, we've developed Antimatter: a double ristretto among Starbucks lattes.This espresso-roast heavyweight rests on a foundation of coffee and chocolate malts blended with silky oats, brown sugar, and a delicate touch of lactose.We pile a trio of very special beans onto that base, all from Budapest's own Bagira Coffee. Two dark roasts are core to the Gravity blend: a milk chocolate, nougat-laden Brazilian, and an El Salvadorian bean full of tobacco and strawberry notes. The third is a very special guest, a medium-roast Yellow Catuai bean from Brazil, naturally-fermented for 120 hours for distinctive aromas of sweet coconut and sour cherry.

text: Our core stout Morning Joe in double edition with more coffee, more cocoa nibs and higher ABV. Enjoy anytime.

name: Asleep In The Deep
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECT TEAM SERIES BENCEAntilles Rum Barrel Aged Imperial Milk Stout With Hazelnut, Cocoa And VanillaCELLAR MASTER NOTESSo the time has finally come when we release a beer that is even thicker than the last one we said was thicker than the previous, again. BUT this time it really is. Tons of lactose, chocolate and NUTs. ELAborating a beer is always full of fun with nuts because the selection is huge and (almost) every one of them is delicious. For the beer, we had a chance to take a chance on a new barrel type and Antilles rum turned out quite good. The results can be circumscribed as a hazelnut-chocolate spread rounded up with vanilla and aged in a rum barrel, for, you know... Reasons. And science.

name: Tiny Barrel Project Madame Kairi
text: Hot Sauce And Mezcal Barrel Aged Imperial StoutA TINY BARREL PROJECT that is unique in every respect, as it is the only one without a previous original release within the SPECIALS series. The launch was scheduled for the time of Tallinn Craft Beer Weekend 2025, after the first day, during the traditional MAD SCIENTIST TTO + MEET THE BREWER event at KOHT.We felt it was important to commemorate a very dear friend, supporter and our Estonian mother, thanks to whom KOHT has always been our home away from home... We always had tap takeovers together during every TCBW, she often came to Budapest to pick up goods in person with her truck, it was always a pleasure to meet her, we event talked about a collab beer last year and this year we fixed it already to do one of the upcoming TINY BARREL PROJECT releases together, as a collab with KOHT. Well, this collab has happened in a different way unfortunately... But it has happened.After TINY BARREL PROJECT SPIRITLORD RUM and TINY BARREL PROJECT CANDY MAN SCOTCH and so, here is our 14th TINY BARREL PROJECT release in our new category between the Specials series and Barrel Project in 330ml cans

name: Black Horchata
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTA Blend Of Imperial Milk Stout And Imperial Porter Aged In Bourbon Barrel With Vanilla And CinnamonCELLAR MASTER NOTESThe king of crowdpleasers, dear Ladies and Gentlemen and other earthlings! Black Horchata launches a smooth attack against your taste buds with the power of vanilla and cinnamon, blackboned (sic!) by a stout full with lactose that has been aged for more than 1 year in a Kentucky bourbon barrel. The name comes from its undeniable similarity with the well-known Mexican soft drink but beyond this, we can't really recommend it for breakfast. You know. It's 11% ABV. Maybe for lunch.

name: Dawn of the Witch
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTGin Barrel-Aged Imperial Milkstout With Spruce Tips, Woodruff, Juniper Berries And Forest FruitsCELLAR MASTER NOTESIt's the dawn of the witchLet go, our spells will lead you higherMore than a year has passed since Night of the Witch cast its pine-scented spell, now the forest reveals a different path. We kept the spruce tips and juniper berries but left the nuttiness behind, conjuring an even more herbal, fruit-kissed incarnation. This time, woodruff takes the lead, a mystical herb with ancient roots, once used in potions, now lending its soft cinnamon, vanilla, and grassy charm. To deepen the magic, we added a handful of dark berries to this potion. It’s an enchanting start to work more frequently with herbs, we hope it will charm you, too.

name: Sugar Daddy
text: SugarDaddy. Imperial Mocha-Toffee Brownie Milk Stout. This is a TuffBuzz x Mad Scientist collaboration beer. ABV 11%.Ingredients: water, malted barley/wheat, yeast, coffee, cocoa, falked wheat, orange blossom extract, vanilla, dark muscovado, carmel, lactose, hops (centennial, lemondrop, pacifica, ahtanum).

name: Dovahkiin
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTIslay Whisky Barrel-aged Smoky Imperial Milk Stout With Habanero ChilliesCELLAR MASTER NOTESAs a dragon shout, this monstrous release arrives with smoke and fire and leaves no tastebuds untouched. When we brewed this beer almost 2 years ago we had a clear concept to make something like a chocolate-smoke-chili cream liquor so we used tons of lactose, got the smokiest barrel we could and used Habanero chilies to add some heat and more smoke. If you like to compare beers, taste it along with the Asleep in the Deep, it has the same base but the additions and barrels make 2 whole different worlds. But beware, don't take too much fire damage!

name: Year of the Tiger
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTBarrel Aged Imperial Milk StoutCELLAR MASTER NOTESBarrelX or Idk but cool anyway.You, beautiful people, loved the NYE2021 blend so much on tap that we decided to create a batch to be bottled as well. This marriage has been set between our previous Barrel Project release "Asleep In The Deep" which arrives with loads of chocolate together with hazelnut and a mixed fermented, wine barrel-aged, black raspberry-infused hawthorn mead. As you can expect, complexity attacks from several directions in the shape of chocolate sweetness, deep fruitiness, playful acidity, nuts, nuts, nuts and more!Saying it's a Black Forest cake would be too obvious and we even used this term before but what could be said? It's pretty much like that and beyond!

name: Darkness Cannot Drive Out Darkness
text: One half of our - three way - collab with Heist Craft from Clowne, UK. Darkness.. is a beautiful chocolate cake imperial stout, for which we used a good amount of cocoa beans, chocolate powder and some lactose. Boiled for 3 hours it's creamy and delicious. Look for the other half, Only Light Can Do That by MONYO x Heist Craft.

name: Elemental Darkness
text: Egy igazán különleges kollaboráció a norvég Badin sörfőzdével – ez az imperial milk stout a selymes testet és az intenzív kakaós karaktert ötvözi az egzotikus kínai ötfűszer keverék (fahéj, koriander, babérlevél, ánizs, szegfűbors) meleg, fűszeres jegyeivel. A gazdag malátakaraktert krémes laktóz támogatja, míg a fűszerek mélységet és izgalmas rétegzettséget adnak a kortynak.A truly special collaboration with Norway’s Badin Brewery – this imperial milk stout combines a silky body and intense cocoa character with the warm, spicy notes of an exotic Chinese five-spice blend (cinnamon, coriander, bay leaf, anise, allspice). The rich malt backbone is supported by creamy lactose, while the spices add depth and intriguing layers to every sip.

name: IMPERIAL MILK STOUT
text: Anglia 1700-as évekbeli exportra szánt söre, mivel a magas alkoholtartalom védte, a hosszú utazással járó megpróbáltatások ellen. Napóleoni háborúk miatt a kereskedelem megszakadt, így rövid idő után ez a sörtípus megsemmisült létezni. Az amerikai sörforradalomnak köszönhetően újraélesztették, és újragondolták. Mi is egy modernebb változatott főztünk rengeteg laktózzal, és bourbon vaníliával. Ui.: Ragadni fog a szád!

name: Beard Doesn't Make You A Brewer.
text: Sörfőzdénk második Extra Milk Stoutja, amibe a laktózon kívül rengeteg pörkölt földimogyoró, vanília és pillecukor is került. A végeredmény pedig folyékony dekadencia: krémes, édes, testes és sűrű desszertsör. Míg illatában eleinte a stílusra jellemző étcsokoládé és pörkölt maláta dominál, némi mogyoróvajas felhanggal, addig ízében már utóbbin van a hangsúly, némi karamellával és melengető alkohollal kiegészülve. Ha két szóban kellene jellemeznünk, azt mondanánk, hogy ilyen lehet a folyékony Snickers.--Our second Extra Milk Stout was brewed with copious amounts of lactose, Madagascar vanilla, marshallows and peanuts. Swirling aromas lift from the glass calling to mind Snickers bars, freshly-made peanut butter and Black Forest gateau. On the palate, notes of peanut butter, baker’s chocolate and caramel are layered over a full, soft mouthfeel.

name: Supermassive - Imperial Stout with Coconut, Cinnamon, and Pecans (2025)
text: Supermassive is the culmination of our high-ABV prototyping program, a project that has been in the works since 2023. Experience from prototypes like the Imperial Oatmeal Stout and the C/M/T have helped us to refine our maximum-gravity process, which now transitions into an ongoing high-ABV series with new releases arriving annually.Prepare yourself for an extreme brew that pushes the limits of our brewhouse, with a 14% ABV and the same rich, velvety foundation that defines Gravity’s Imperial range. Packed with roasted malts and silky oats, the Supermassive base showcases tons of chocolate, coffee, and dark caramel character. This huge base demands an extra long infusion on two different toasted oaks, specifically chosen to further deepen the rum and vanilla character.For this first edition of Supermassive, coconut sugar, coconut water, and toasted coconut flakes provide the backbone of the flavour: complex, fragrant, roasted coconut notes with a hint of salinity. Stacked onto that base are cinnamon buds which dominate the nose with a captivating aroma of soft, fruity winter spice, while toasted pecans finish the sip with a lingering nutty richness.

name: Prototype: Imperial Oatmeal Stout
text: Our newest Prototype is an Imperial Oatmeal Stout, and the start of something big here at Gravity!This dark, rich, and roasty brew is an all-new in-house imperial base inspired by San Diego’s legendary Modern Times, and their Devil’s Teeth series of more than 100 different imperial stouts. Think huge doses of malted oats, backed up by tones of chocolate, coffee, and complex caramel. A light touch of lactose balances the body, while organic coconut sugar helps the finish linger on the palate.This project will serve as the foundation for a new series of limited-release high-ABV beers, which we'll build on with new ingredients and infusion techniques to unleash bold new flavors and aromas.

name: Night Shift Vintage 2024 - Imperial Pastry Stout Aged In Bourbon Barrels With Hazelnut & Caramel
text: Pető Kristóf sörfőzőnk ötlete. Az alap Imperial Stout, aminek jellegzetes csokis ízjegyei mellé igazából bármilyen csoki-ihletésű dolog illik, most kapott egy jó nagy adag mogyorótöretet és karamellt. A sör maga Bourbon hordókban érlelődött, hogy az alap ízjegyek kapjanak egy kis whiskey-s, hordós tuningot. The base is an Imperial Stout, whose distinctive chocolate notes pair well with any chocolate-inspired addition, and now it’s been given a generous amount of crushed hazelnuts and caramel. The beer itself was aged in Bourbon barrels to give the base flavors a touch of whiskey and barrel-aged finesse.

name: Night Shift Vintage 2023 - Vanilla & Cinnamon Bundt Cake Pastry Stout Aged In Tennessee Whiskey Barrels
text: Fahéjjal és vaníliával fűszerezett Pastry Stout, amelynek alapötlete a kuglóf volt. Az alapsör HBC 472 komlóval készült, amely segített elmélyíteni a hordós érlelés során átvett Tennessee whiskey hordók fás, hihetetlenül vaníliás ízjegyeit. A tökéletes ízvilágát a hozzáadott fahéjjal érte el ez a testes, zamatos sörkülönlegesség. This bottle hides an Imperial Pastry Stout made with cinnamon and vanilla, based on the idea of true love and a bundt cake.The base beer is made with American experimental hops called HBC 472, which helps to deepen the woody, vanilla flavors of the Tennessee whiskey barrels used during barrel maturation. In order to achieve the perfect taste, we added cinnamon to the beer's mouthfeel to achieve this gourmet beer specialty.

name: Night Shift Vintage 2022 Imperial Pecan Pie Stout Aged In Tennessee Whiskey Barrels
text: A Horizont Night Shift tételei között minden évben megtalálható egy pastry stout. A 2022-es év „sütis” Night Shiftjéhez egy klasszikus amerikai süteményt, a pekándiós pitét vettük alapul. A pekándiós pite története az 1880-as évekig tekint vissza, és kimondottan kedvelt az USA deli államaiban, ahol a bourbon whiskey-t készítik, így természetesnek vettük, hogy hordóérleléshez egy Tennessee whiskey-s hordót válasszunk. Mivel a lepárló, ahonnan érkezett, karakteresebb, számottevően vaníliásabb esszenciájú hordókat használ, így ez fantasztikusan áll az alapsörnek, illetve a teljes koncepciónak is. Az alapsör egy sűrű, testes imperial stout, amibe rengeteg házilag pörkölt pekándiót tettünk, így kinyerve belőle az ízeket.ENEach year in the Horizont Night Shift line, we present to you a new pastry stout. The 2022 version is an expression of an American classic dessert, the pecan pie. The Pecan pie dates back to the 1880’s and is very popular in the Southern States where bourbon whiskey is made, so it was a natural fit to age this beer in Tennessee whiskey barrels. The distillery from which the barrels came emphasizes considerably more vanilla essence which is perfect for this brew. The base beer is an Imperial Stout which is a thick, full-bodied beer which was put into the barrels then we added copious amounts of home-roasted pecans, thus extracting the flavors from it. Enjoy this special beer!

name: Sweet Spot
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTA Blend Of Double Barrel (Bourbon & Sherry) Aged Imperial Stout And Tequila Barrel Aged MeadCELLAR MASTER NOTESIn the perpetual seek for an optimum point or combination of factors or qualitiesWe are about to release our first Barre Project stout-mead hybrid and we couldn't be more excited. To grab life by the throat we picked a medium-dry imperial stout that was aged for almost 2 years in 2 barrels (first Bourbon, then Oloroso sherry) and we mixed it with a sweet mead that sat in a tequila barrel for more than a year. The result is a brand new category, at least from our point of view, where chocolate, berries, and the spicy-sweet honey characters are the main pillars, but beyond that oakiness, vanilla and a whole bunch of other paper-thin notes collide, you know, just to make sure you can find your sweet spot!

name: Beeznuts
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTA Blend Of Bourbon Barrel Aged Imperial Stout And Also Bourbon Barrel-aged Mead With Hand Roasted Pistachios And WalnutCELLAR MASTER NOTESI Hustle EverydayAs a direct successor of Sweet Spot, this following release brings the sweet-honeylike-chocolaty notes of the 'Spot, but adds the bourbonish vanilla together with generously added and carefully roasted walnuts and pistachios. We don't need to sell the story of this mead-imperial stout crossover line, because it's not a story, it's the real deal and we hope you'll enjoy it as much as we do. "Money cannot buy happiness, it's true what they say, but a mad scientist still got bills to pay, so I hustle every day!"

name: Flódni
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTJamaican And Cuban Rum Barrel Aged Imperial Pastry Stout With Plum, Apple, Walnut And Poppy SeedsCELLAR MASTER NOTESAs we roll further down the road to total madness we bumped into something, again, that is totally worth stopping by: Flódni, a Jewish pastry, one of the best cakes you could ever try. It's a heavily layered treat filled with apple, plum, poppyseed, walnut, citrus zests and cinnamon. We managed to translate this creation into a thick, fully packed, sweet dessert beer that was aged in Cuban and Jamaican rum barrels for more than a year to get extra spicy. It's a perfect union of (not so) contrary things!

name: Tiny Barrel Project Biscuit Behemoth
text: From 2018 COOKIE MONSTER chocolate chip imperial stout to 2023's first half's BISCUIT BEHEMOTH cookies & cream imperial stout ending up with 2023's second half's TINY BARREL PROJECT BISCUIT BEHEMOTH COGNAC barrel-aged chocolate cookies & vanilla cream imperial stout w/ Beer Brothers Budapest.Following TINY BARREL PROJECT SPIRITLORD RUM and TINY BARREL PROJECT SPIRITLORD BOURBON, here is our third TINY BARREL PROJECT release in our new category between the Specials series and Barrel Project in 330ml cans.

name: Night Shift Vintage 2025 / Peanut Butter Jelly Imperial Pastry Stout Aged In Pedro Ximénez Sherry Barrels
text: Gyerekkor legjobb szendvicse - csak felnőtteknek. Egy gazdag, testes imperial stout mogyoróvajjal, amit Pedro Ximénez sherry hordókban érleltünk. A végeredmény selymes, desszertszerű, tele pörkölt mogyorós, karamelles, mazsolás és lekváros jegyekkel, az érlelés pedig édeskés, boros-fügés mélységet ad.-The best childhood sandwich – for grown-ups. A rich, full-bodied imperial stout infused with peanut butter and aged in Pedro Ximénez sherry barrels. Silky and dessert-like, with roasted peanut, caramel, raisin and jam notes, rounded out by sweet, winey, fig-like barrel depth.

name: Night Shift Vintage 2021 Imperial Pastry Stout Aged In Rhum Barrels
text: This Imperial Pastry Stout is aged in Rhum barrels, to give a nice layer for the additional spices we used during the brewing and aging process. The used adjuncts are coca nibs, ethipoean coffee, cinnamon and vanilla.

name: Night Shift Vintage 2025 / Imperial Pastry Stout Aged In Rum Barrels With Coconut & Chocolate
text: Folytatjuk az Imperial Pastry Stout sorozatunkat, most pedig egy különleges tétellel! Inspirációnk a közkedvelt kókuszkocka volt, és elkészült a sör verziója – tényleg olyan, mintha kókuszkockát kortyolnál. Rumoshordókban érleltük, kókuszpehellyel és kakaóbabbal, hogy minden korty a klasszikus rumos-kókuszos-csokis ízeket hozza el neked. Egészségedre! -We’re continuing our Imperial Pastry Stout series with a very special release. Inspired by the beloved coconut cube, we’ve created a beer that tastes just like it. Aged in rum barrels from Barbados, with coconut flakes and cocoa nibs, this stout captures the classic rum, coconut, and chocolate flavors in every sip. Cheers!

Inspired by the hungarian dessert? Check. Jamaican rum barrel aged? Check. Creamy stout with notes of raisins and rum? Check. The only difference is what is more accented. Same content with a little bit different presentation.

name: Corvus Corax
text: ENA massive, dense Imperial Stout made with our friends at Vogelsang. One of the densest in terms of taste and texture, it is especially for fans of full-bodied stouts and those who escape the trap of General Winter with a warming, stout beer.Candy sugar and maple syrup both leave their recognizable mark on our caramelly, brownie-like batch, which is complemented by the flavors of nuts and cookies and makes it totally pastry-like.DEEin massives, dichtes Imperial Stout, das wir mit unseren Freunden von Vogelsangos gebraut haben. Es ist eines der dichtesten in Bezug auf Geschmack und Textur und eignet sich besonders für Fans vollmundiger Stouts und für alle, die der Falle des General Winter mit einem wärmenden, kräftigen Bier entfliehen möchten.Sowohl Kandiszucker als auch Ahornsirup hinterlassen ihre unverwechselbare Note auf unserer Karamell-Brownie-Charge, die durch die Aromen von Nüssen und Keksen ergänzt wird und sie absolut gebäckartig macht.HUVogelsangos barátainkkal közösen készített masszív, sűrű Imperial Stout. Kortyérzetre, textúrára az eddigi egyik legsűrűbb darab, kifejezetten a testes stoutok rajongóinak és azoknak, akik Tél Tábornok csapdájából egy melengető, vaskos sörrel menekülnek.A kandiscukor és juharszirup mind rányomják felismerhető bélyegüket karamelles, brownies tételünkre, melyet a dió és a keksz ízei egészítenek ki és tesznek totálisan péksüteményszerűvé.

name: The Marshmallow Fellow
text: Amikor nem is számítasz rá... amikor békésen hallgatod a tűz ropogását... eljön érted a Marshmallow Fellow! A sűrű, ragacsos sötétségből veti rád magát, hogy elsőre kókuszos kekszre, másodikra már forrón olvadó pillecukorra emlékeztető ízkavalkádjával fektessen két vállra!When you least expect it... when there's only the peaceful crackling of the fire... the Marshmallow Fellow comes for you! He lurches at you from the deep, sticky darkness, to knock you out with a cacophony of flavours - coconut biscuit first, melted marshmallow second!
